name: bluestars
description: Connect your Bluestars account to review dashboard analytics, usage, widget conversations, and BSR customer and visitor insights. Retrieve API integration details and widget installation snippets, and generate BSR text variants when your permissions allow it. Access follows your account permissions and plan. Postcode lookups can consume credits; text generation can populate the widget content cache.
